_comment: One icon per project (the GitHub 'Project: …' parent issue in THIS repo, keyed by its number). Same shape and same rules as sf-ops/scripts/status-page/projects.json: a project-level session is '<icon> <name>', a ticket session is '<icon><ticketMark> #<n> · <title>'. Icons must not reuse any icon in the sf-ops file (🐞 🤖 📥 🧰 💵 📐 🔩 🗂️ 🗺️, plus 📊 🧭 🛠️ 📁), because Sonja sees every session side by side. The website build is a project of its own, '🌐 SF Website', on the one status board (sf-ops #387). A new Project issue adds its line here in the same PR that creates it.
